product_family: Developer email API (transactional + marketing email delivery), with add-ons for audiences/broadcasts, inbound email, React Email template library, and webhooks; single product tier structure (Free/Pro/Scale/Enterprise) rather than separate consumer vs enterprise products.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Resend is SOC 2 Type II compliant. The auditing was done by Advantage Partners which has a track record of partnering with many SaaS companies. The reporting period is from February 1, 2025 to February 1, 2026. Resend also uses Vanta to monitor, collect, and submit evidence to auditors.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a separate Type I report; Resend's own blog post frames its first audit directly as a Type II covering August 1, 2023 to February 1, 2024 ("passed our first Type II audit with zero exceptions"), with no mention of a prior Type I.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not listed on resend.com/security, the SOC 2 page, the Enterprise page, or the GDPR page. Resend's own GDPR page contrasts itself with ISO 27001 only rhetorically ("Unlike SOC 2 or ISO 27001, GDPR is not a best practice standard...") without claiming ISO 27001 for itself.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or BAA availability. The Enterprise page and DPA make no mention of HIPAA or Business Associate Agreements.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Resend does not process cardholder data directly (billing is handled via Stripe as a subprocessor); no PCI DSS claim found on any vendor page.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certifiable standard)
certifications.proof_quote: Resend is GDPR compliant. We have made it a priority to protect your data. ... Resend also uses Vanta to monitor all GDPR controls and organize evidence for compliance.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) + UK Extension
certifications.proof_quote: Being certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and the UK Extension to the EU-US DPF allows us to better support customers in the EU and the UK. [Resend has] long been SOC 2 and GDPR compliant.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No AI-governance certification is mentioned on any Resend security, trust, or enterprise page.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Resend's own domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Resend's own domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: The Privacy Policy contains no statement addressing whether customer email content is used for AI/ML model training, and Resend's product is an email-delivery API, not a generative-AI product, so no dedicated AI-training disclosure page exists. The nav link labeled "AI" on resend.com resolved to a 404, so no evidence could be gathered either way; recorded as unknown rather than assumed.
privacy.data_region: Sending region is selectable (US, EU/Ireland, Brazil, Japan) but all account data, email metadata, logs, and API records are stored in the United States regardless of sending region, per Resend's own docs.

security.name: DDoS protection
security.value: Automatic protection from Layer 7 (application) and Layer 3 SYN-flood attacks

security.name: API key scoping
security.value: API keys can be created with limited access and different permission levels

security.name: Backups
security.value: Daily backups, retained for one week

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular penetration tests conducted by third-party security firms

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Responsible Disclosure program listed alongside SOC 2 / GDPR on the security page

security.name: Continuous compliance monitoring
security.value: Vanta used to monitor SOC 2 and GDPR controls and collect audit evidence in real time

products.name: Resend Email API (transactional + marketing)
products.category: Developer email sending API / SMTP / SDKs
products.data_scope: Email content, recipient PII (addresses, names), delivery/engagement events (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints)
products.notes: Core product; account/log data stored in US only regardless of chosen send region.

products.name: Audiences / Broadcasts
products.data_scope: Contact lists, subscriber attributes, broadcast analytics
products.notes: Same underlying compliance posture as core API; no separate certification scope disclosed.

products.name: React Email
products.data_scope: None (client-side template code, no data processed by Resend)
products.notes: Open source project, not itself a hosted service subject to Resend's compliance program.

products.name: Enterprise plan
products.data_scope: Same data scope as core API
products.notes: Adds SSO/legal-document redlining and questionnaire support (Enterprise Plan required to request DPA changes); no distinct enterprise-only cert (e.g. no HIPAA/BAA) found.

compare.pricing_model: Usage-based tiers (Free, Pro, Scale) plus custom Enterprise plan
compare.data_residency: Send region selectable (US/EU/Brazil/Japan); all stored account/metadata is US-only

flags: No HIPAA/BAA offering found despite Resend being usable for sending patient-facing transactional email; buyers in healthcare should not assume HIPAA coverage without contacting Resend directly.
AI-training posture on customer/email data is undocumented; no dedicated statement appears in the Privacy Policy, so it should not be assumed either safe or unsafe.

All stored account/log data resides in the US even when EU send region is selected; EU customers relying on data residency for compliance should read the DPA (SCCs) and DPF certification, not assume EU data residency.
